discovery.title: The WNBA Finals are headed to a first-ever Game 7
discovery.summary: Atlanta beat Golden State in Game 6 on October 29, forcing a deciding game in the WNBA Finals for the first time in league history.
discovery.why_it_matters: A winner-take-all finale can turn a season into one high-pressure night—and bring new attention to the teams, players and league.
